t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Focus on the link between the gnomes' colours and the forests they lead you to, making sure to continue to choose the forest that will give you the most mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: There are two important things to note:First: The gnomes will appear in fixed pairs - orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow, blue & purple. Their positions may vary but they will always appear in these pairs.Second: Each gnome within a pair will lead you to a different forest - one to a bright forest with a red basket & the other to a dark forest with a yellow basket. Specifically the orange, green, red and blue gnomes will lead you to the bright forest whilst the brown, purple, yellow and pink gnomes will take you to the dark forest.Your goal is to consistently reach the forest that currently has the most mushrooms. Be aware that the forest with the most mushrooms may change so keep in mind the which gnome leads you to which forest and adjust your choices. Use the 1x multipliers to test out which forest has the most mushrooms at first and then focus on making the most out of the 5x multipliers. The gnomes' size, position and hat type are irrelevant. Maintain focus on the colour, forest and probability of highest mushrooms and you'll be able to succeed. Good Luck!
